label: the shipped graphics profiles, steady state, night in the village
comment: The other half of profiles.json. The tiers differ on shadow_lamps (16,
8, 0) and light_pool (96, 64, 48), and both are free at noon in a
scene with nothing lit in it: measured at the vista they read as no
difference, which is true of that scene and false of the client.
So this is the same three profiles, standing in the village after
dark where the lamps are the frame. Steady state only, which makes it
a live sweep: one process, one block set, one light pool, the setting
the only thing that moves between variants. Load and streaming are
profiles.json's job and are not repeated here.
The variants are project/graphics_profiles.gd key for key, as there.
view_range, lod_distance and far_distance are carried even though
this scene cannot show them, because a profile is measured as a whole
or it is not the profile.
